description: Kingpin Market brings the fingerboard marketplace into ChatGPT. Search live public listings for decks, wheels, trucks, completes, tuning parts, gifts, and rare drops; compare prices and condition; build setup ideas by width, budget, brand, or skill level; and get a safe hand-off link back to Kingpin Market when you are ready to view or buy. Public tools are read-only and only return active marketplace listings. Checkout, messaging, payments, seller account actions, and private account data stay on Kingpin Market.
